headline: Yemeni Forces Claim 474 Strikes in 24 Hours
deck: Yemeni government forces claimed 474 jet and drone strikes over 24 hours, 1,540 Houthi fighters killed or wounded mostly in Taiz, and 216 pieces of equipment destroyed.
body: Yemeni government spokesman Majid al-Nuzaili said on X that government forces had carried out 474 strikes and targeting operations against the Houthis using fighter jets, drones, and other weapons. [E1] The army said Friday the operations ran against Houthi targets on several fronts over the previous 24 hours. [E3]
He claimed the strikes had killed or wounded 1,540 Houthi fighters, most of them in Taiz, and destroyed or disabled 216 pieces of military equipment. [E2][E4]
